presentation.label: Two-operator FM
presentation.summary: Two-operator FM with a dedicated track machine, one to four voices, chords and glide.
presentation.overview: Choose FM SYNTH alongside FLEX and STATIC. Tim Hastie’s two-operator FM engine generates audio on the ColdFire CPU, with one to four paraphonic voices feeding the existing track AMP, filters and effects. The dedicated machine keeps sample slots intact and needs no marker WAV. This experimental release has emulator playback and native/browser composition evidence; hardware and worst-case chip timing remain untested/unmeasured.
highlights: Dedicated machine chooser entry; no sample required.
Pitch, ratio, index, fine tuning, feedback and index decay on SRC.
One to four paraphonic voices, chord shapes and inversions.
Chromatic playing, MIDI, legato and privately bundled scale/glide controls.
usage: Open a disposable project with FM Synth firmware. Select an audio track, hold FUNC and press SRC, select FM SYNTH with UP/DOWN and press YES. No sample is required.
Press SRC. Set RATO to 1 and turn INDX from 0 upwards to hear a sine tone acquire FM harmonics. PTCH transposes it; FINE tunes it in cents; FDBK adds feedback; DEC shortens the modulation envelope.
Place a trig and press PLAY. Press LFO to set VOIC to 2–4 and CHRD to a chord if wanted. AMP ATK/HOLD/REL shape the gain envelope; FUNC+AMP exposes LEG.
Press STOP twice to silence the voice. To return to a sample machine, hold FUNC and press SRC, select FLEX or STATIC and press YES; assign the desired sample in the normal way.

access.location: Audio track > FUNC+SRC > FM SYNTH; SRC for tone, LFO for voices/chords, FUNC+AMP for LEG.
steps: Open a disposable project with FM Synth firmware. Select an audio track, hold FUNC and press SRC, select FM SYNTH with UP/DOWN and press YES. No sample is required.
Press SRC. Set RATO to 1 and turn INDX from 0 upwards to hear a sine tone acquire FM harmonics. PTCH transposes it; FINE tunes it in cents; FDBK adds feedback; DEC shortens the modulation envelope.
Place a trig and press PLAY. Press LFO to set VOIC to 2–4 and CHRD to a chord if wanted. AMP ATK/HOLD/REL shape the gain envelope; FUNC+AMP exposes LEG.
Press STOP twice to silence the voice. To return to a sample machine, hold FUNC and press SRC, select FLEX or STATIC and press YES; assign the desired sample in the normal way.
For scales and glide, open PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER. Select SCALE, ROOT or GLIDE with UP/DOWN and turn LEVEL. SCALE OFF restores unquantized pitch.

controls.name: PTCH
controls.doc: SRC A: raw 64 is 0 semitones; raw 0–127 gives −64…+63. Scale and chromatic edits can constrain pitch.

controls.name: RATO
controls.doc: SRC B: raw>>2 selects 32 modulation ratios from 0.25 to 16; default raw 12 gives ratio 1.

controls.name: INDX
controls.doc: SRC C: FM modulation depth, raw 0–127. Zero produces the unmodulated carrier.

controls.name: FINE
controls.doc: SRC D: raw 64 is 0 cents; raw 0–127 gives −64…+63 cents.

controls.name: FDBK
controls.doc: SRC E: modulation-operator feedback, raw 0–127. Extreme feedback can be bright and alias.

controls.name: DEC
controls.doc: SRC F: modulation-index decay. Default raw 40 displays about 199 ms. This is separate from the AMP gain envelope.

controls.name: VOIC
controls.doc: LFO C: effective voice count 1–4. Values outside 1–4, including raw 0, normalize to one voice. Initial inherited LFO value displays one; four voices share the track filter and AMP.

controls.name: CHRD
controls.doc: LFO F: 32 chord shapes with four inversions each, encoded as shape<<2 | inversion. ---- uses individual played/recorded notes.

controls.name: LEG
controls.doc: FUNC+AMP F: OFF retriggers, MONO preserves one envelope across overlapping keys, POLY enables paraphonic legato. Ordinary sample tracks expose OFF/MONO.

controls.name: SCALE
controls.doc: OFF restores stock pitch behavior; select a scale to constrain PTCH edits, locks and chromatic keys.

controls.name: ROOT
controls.doc: Root of the scale and chromatic keyboard. Ignored with SCALE OFF.

controls.name: GLIDE
controls.doc: OFF or 1–127 slide time; the track LEG setting controls legato.

limitations: Parts store stock FLEX kind 1 plus FM/1 in unused NEIGHBOR control bytes. A stock build reads the track as FLEX; it does not synthesize FM. Choose stock explicitly before downgrading.
LFO3 speed/depth become VOIC/CHRD; LFO3 depth is muted. ATK/HOLD/REL remain inherited stock AMP controls and drive the synth’s own envelope.
The matching quantizer is bundled privately because the engine shares its mailbox and fixed scale accessor. Do not also select the public Scale Quantizer.

Cannot combine with Analog BD or the public Scale Quantizer because their native hooks overlap. Compatible mixed builds have native/browser byte-parity evidence; mixed audio loads have not been stress-tested.
Saved project/Part reloads, MIDI, chords, legato, modulation, maximum simultaneous voices and hardware timing remain unqualified.
Historical upstream marker-FLEX activation remains for compatibility; the verified route is the dedicated FM SYNTH chooser.

resources.recorded: Build extents and source estimates; chip timing and complete memory bounds owner-waived

storage.label: Shared audio arena reservation
storage.conditions: Shared native platform reservation of 1,707 × 6,144-byte pages. This is not the exact incremental FM memory cost: complete code/state/table/stack/padding and peak lifetime accounting remains pending.

processing.label: ColdFire synthesis
processing.conditions: CF computes each FM sample and up to four voices per track. Parameter modulation, MIDI, mode changes and maximum eight-track loads have not been priced.

impact.conditions: Estimates for eight FM tracks with up to four voices each; no measured comparison or real-time guarantee.

cpu.rationale: Per-sample two-operator FM and multiple voice/envelope/chord/glide paths execute on ColdFire.

dsp.rationale: No new DSP algorithm; generated audio passes through existing stock source, AMP and effect processing.

memory.rationale: The native platform reserves a shared 10 MiB audio arena plus synth/quantizer state and page clones.

tests.summary: Native panel/storage checks and sample-free playback passed. Shared native/browser comparison passed 94 cases (37 builds, 57 refusals); update packaging and changed-base refusals passed. Hardware is untested; worst-case chip cycles and complete stack/lifetime memory bounds are unmeasured under this exact owner-approved experimental release exception.

releaseWaiver.reason: Owner explicitly approved this experimental release without current hardware evidence, worst-case chip timing or complete stack/memory bounds. Those quantities remain unknown.
